summary: Citizen and carpenter of Munzingen, the earliest recorded ancestor of the Meier line; John's 5th-great-grandfather.
bio:
Michael Mayer was a citizen (Bürger) and carpenter (Zimmermann) of Munzingen, near Freiburg im Breisgau in Baden, and is John's 5th-great-grandfather. He is known from the record of his son Heinrich's marriage in 1820, which names him; the record does not name his wife, and his own birth and death dates are unknown. He stands as the earliest known ancestor of John's Meier line.

He began a family tradition in the building trades that ran through four generations: Michael was a carpenter, his son Heinrich a mason, his grandson Friedrich a stone mason and his great-grandson Henry an iron moulder.

residences.place: Munzingen, Freiburg im Breisgau, Baden-Württemberg, Germany

researchNotes: Michael Mayer was a citizen (Bürger) and carpenter of Munzingen, named in his son Heinrich's 1820 marriage. His wife is not named there and his dates are not found. FamilySearch lists him as a bare name (PW7H-2P6). If he died 1810–39 his death is in the L 10 Nr. 1590 'Todtfälle' sections (not fully scanned). Four generations of the family worked in building trades: Michael carpenter, Heinrich mason, Friedrich stone mason, Henry iron moulder.
